name: Flexatech AI Customer Support
author: FlexaTech

sections.description:
Flexatech AI Customer Support adds a chat assistant to your site. It answers from your pages, posts, products, FAQs and PDFs, says where each answer came from, and passes the conversation to your team when a person is needed.

  • A chat bubble on the front end, with suggested questions. A suggestion can carry your own written answer, which the widget shows without calling the AI.
  • A knowledge index built from your content, kept up to date as you edit posts.
  • Tickets: when the assistant cannot help, the visitor leaves an email and your team gets the question.
  • Conversations, knowledge gaps and usage stats in the admin, plus a daily spending limit.
  • It uses the AI Client built into WordPress, so it works with whichever AI provider you connect under Settings > Connectors.

External services

This plugin talks to the services below. Nothing goes to an AI provider until you connect one in WordPress, and the chat widget stays off until you turn it on.

The AI provider you connect in WordPress

The plugin does not call any AI service itself. It uses the AI Client that ships with WordPress 7.0 and later, and the provider is whichever one you connect under Settings > Connectors (for example Anthropic, OpenAI or Google). Your key is stored and used by WordPress. Through the AI Client, the plugin sends:

  • when a visitor chats: the visitor’s message, the conversation so far, the parts of your site content that match the question, and the title and address of the page the visitor is on;
  • when you add PDFs to the knowledge: the whole PDF file, so the provider can read its text;
  • when you use “Test connection”, the test chat in the admin, the conversation summary, the FAQ draft or the business details draft: the text of that request.

What the provider does with that data is set by its own terms and privacy policy, which you accept when you connect it.

Cloudflare Turnstile (optional)

Used only when you enter a Turnstile site key and secret in Settings. When a visitor opens many chats in a short time, the widget loads the Turnstile script from challenges.cloudflare.com in the visitor’s browser and shows a check. The plugin then sends the check’s token, your secret and the visitor’s IP address to Cloudflare to verify it. Terms: https://www.cloudflare.com/website-terms/. Privacy: https://www.cloudflare.com/turnstile-privacy-policy/

Pages on other sites (optional)

The assistant can open a page to answer a question about it. It opens pages on your own site, and on other sites only when you list their domains in Settings. It requests the page like a browser would and sends no visitor data.

Deactivation feedback (Flexa Product Intelligence)

When you go to deactivate Flexatech AI Customer Support on the Plugins screen, a short optional survey asks why. It is served by Flexa’s product intelligence service at https://product-intelligence.flexacommerce.com. It runs only on wp-admin/plugins.php, never on the front end, and it never blocks deactivation. No chat, visitor or knowledge data is ever sent to it.

What is sent, and when:

  • On opening the Plugins screen: a request to /api/v1/config (product slug and tier) to load the survey configuration. The answer is cached for 6 hours.
  • When you deactivate or use the survey: the reason you pick and any optional message you type, sent to /api/v1/deactivations, /api/v1/events, /api/v1/feedback, /api/v1/feature-requests and /api/v1/recovery-events.

Every request includes an anonymous per-site identifier (a random UUID), the plugin version and tier, and by default your WordPress version, PHP version and locale. No email, site domain, user identity or raw IP address is collected. To stop sending the environment details, use add_filter( 'fxai_deactivation_survey_config', fn( $c ) => [ 'collect_environment' => false ] + $c );. To turn the survey off completely, use add_filter( 'fxai_deactivation_survey_enabled', '__return_false' );.

Service terms: https://flexacommerce.com/pages/terms. Privacy policy: https://flexacommerce.com/pages/privacy

Source code

The admin screen and the chat widget are written in TypeScript and built with Vite. The human-readable source ships with the plugin:

  • apps/admin/src: the admin app (React), built to assets/dist/admin.js and assets/dist/admin.css.
  • apps/widget/src: the chat widget, built to assets/dist/widget.js.
  • assets/js/widget-loader.js is plain JavaScript and is not compiled.

To build it yourself, install Node.js 20 and pnpm, then run pnpm install and pnpm build in the plugin folder. package.json, pnpm-lock.yaml, and the vite.config.ts and tsconfig.json of each app are included.
sections.changelog:
1.0.1

  • New: an optional short survey when you deactivate the plugin, asking why. It never blocks deactivation and can be turned off with a filter (see External services).

1.0.0

  • First release: chat widget, knowledge index, tickets, suggested questions with ready answers, conversations, stats and settings.
